description: Source code implementing a Windows-specific raster handle allocator for Skia graphics library, including functions for creating and managing HDC and HBITMAP objects, and integrating with Skia's platform canvas.

classes.name: GDIAllocator
classes.description: A subclass of SkRasterHandleAllocator that provides HDC handles for Skia raster operations.

methods.name: DeleteHDCCallback
methods.description: Callback to delete HDC and associated bitmap resources.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an HDC and associated bitmap for raster operations.

methods.name: allocHandle
methods.description: Allocates a handle (HDC) for Skia raster handle allocator.

methods.name: updateHandle
methods.description: Updates the handle with transformation and clipping.

methods.name: CreatePlatformCanvasWithSharedSection
methods.description: Creates a Skia platform canvas with shared memory section, using GDI if available.

methods.name: GetNativeDrawingContext
methods.description: Retrieves the native HDC from a Skia canvas.
